drawings.description: un diagramme à demi biffé, en partie écrit tête-bêche : des produits $P^1 \times P$, $P^0 \times_P P \rightrightarrows P_1 \to P$, des flèches verticales et une flèche courbe ; les termes ne se lisent pas assez pour être composés
drawings.notes: Three rows: at the top, a struck stretch with a product and a double arrow; in the middle P^1 x P with two vertical arrows; at the bottom P^0 x_P P => P_1 -> P; a curved arrow on the left from the top row down to the bottom row; an upward arrow to an X on the right. Labels after the transcription (the letters on the card read like a script P); the struck top row is drawn grey and its terms are not composed; the scribble below the right end is left out. The upside-down writing of the card is not part of the figure.

drawings.description: sous ce système, une flèche montante $\underline{B} \to \underline{\mathrm{Pic}}^{0}_{X/S}$ et une flèche oblique, barrée d'un trait, de $\underline{\mathrm{Pic}}^{0}_{\underline{A}^{1}/S}$ vers $\underline{B}$ ; le croquis s'arrête au bas de la page
drawings.notes: The system X -> A^1_{X/S}, Pic^0_{X/S} <- Pic^0_{A^1/S} = Pic^0_{A^0/S} with the brace on its left, and under it the upward arrow B -> Pic^0_{X/S} and the oblique arrow from Pic^0_{A^1/S} down towards B, crossed by a short stroke. The page ends below.

drawings.description: deux droites qui se coupent en un point, chacune marquée « 1 » à son extrémité droite.
drawings.notes: Two lines crossing at a point (a dot), each marked 1 at its right end.

drawings.description: en marge, un petit tableau incliné, à colonnes, où se lisent $\mathrm{Div}^+$ et quelques mots illisibles
drawings.notes: A tilted, roughly trapezoidal frame with four column lines; the words written in it are not reproduced except Div^+ (after the transcription), placed where a "Div" is visible in the lower right cell. The outline is approximate.

drawings.description: en marge gauche, le carré de changement de base, avec $Z$ et $Z'$ au-dessus de la ligne du haut
drawings.notes: The square X <- X', down to S <- S', with Z above X and Z' above X'. The first Z carries a small mark that may be a prime or a question mark (the transcription reads Z).

drawings.description: en marge, sous un trait : $D$, $D'=D^{(1)}_R$, $D'_\eta$ au-dessus de $X\xleftarrow{p_1}R\supset R^{(2)}_\eta$, avec $p_2\colon R\to X$ vers le bas
drawings.notes: Under a horizontal rule: D, D' = D^{(1)}_R, D'_eta in a row, above X <-(p_1) R contains R^{(2)}_eta; p_2 goes down from R to X. Short vertical strokes under X and under R^{(2)}_eta, and a mark like "?" at the lower right, are drawn as strokes / left out.

drawings.description: dans la boucle du diagramme, une tête coiffée d'un chapeau à large bord
drawings.kind: doodle: head with a wide-brimmed hat
drawings.notes: Overinked: a thick closed outline (the brim of the hat, or the loop of the diagram passing round the head) and inside it a face with a horizontal bar and a short vertical stroke, the lower part filled. The two lines of the diagram that reach it from the left are drawn. Approximate shape.

drawings.description: figure : les composantes $X_i$, $X_j$ découpées dans $X$ par des arcs, $Y_i$ et $Y_j$ portés sur elles, $X_{ij}$ et $Z_{ij}$ marqués au point d'intersection, avec flèches vers les étiquettes
drawings.kind: components of a scheme cut by arcs
drawings.notes: Several crossing strokes and arcs cut the region into pieces; a heavy point where several strokes meet; a long stroke from that point to the upper right and a narrow wedge on the right. Labels placed after the transcription: X (top left, with a curved arrow), Y_i, X_ij (near the upper crossing), Y_j with an arrow, Z_ij (right). Which piece is X_i and which X_j cannot be told; the small "ij)" under the heavy point is left out.

drawings.description: à gauche, deux petits diagrammes : $Z \xrightarrow{i} X$, $Z$ fermé, avec $f \colon X \to S$ et $\varphi \colon Z \to S$ ; et le triangle $X \to \Sigma \to S$, $X \to S$ ; un troisième croquis du même triangle, isolé au bas de la page
drawings.notes: Upper: the triangle X -> Sigma -> S with X -> S. Lower: Z -(i?)-> X (an inclusion sign with a small mark above it), f: X -> S upwards, phi: Z -> S as a thin oblique arrow, and the word "fermé" to the left of Z. The long pencil lines crossing the lower right of the page are not drawn; the mirror text shows through from the back.

figures.what: triangle X -> Sigma -> S, X -> S
Z -> X closed, f: X -> S, phi: Z -> S

drawings.disagreement: On the facsimile both diagrams are at the lower right of the page, not on the left, and only two sketches are visible: no third copy of the triangle was found at the bottom of the page.

drawings.description: schéma du terme $E_2$ : deux lignes de croix au-dessus de l'axe horizontal, la première croix de la ligne supérieure marquée d'un astérisque
drawings.kind: E_2 term: crosses above an axis
drawings.notes: A horizontal axis and a vertical axis; two rows of four crosses above the horizontal axis. The heavy, asterisk-like cross is the first cross of the LOWER row, on the vertical axis.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription puts the asterisk on the first cross of the upper row; on the facsimile the heavy cross is the first of the lower row.

drawings.description: cinq segments de droite se coupant deux à deux en formant un pentagone
drawings.kind: five lines forming a pentagon (cycle of components)
drawings.notes: Five line segments, each crossing its two neighbours, forming a pentagon (a cycle in the combinatorial scheme of C). Not encoded: a cycle of five rational components with no legs is not a stable graph, and no other schema fits.

drawings.description: page de croquis de courbes stables : configurations de composantes rationnelles (traits) se coupant transversalement, l'une marquée $g$ ; une autre à deux composantes marquées $g'$ et $g''$, avec
drawings.kind: sketches of stable curves (configurations of lines)
drawings.notes: Top: three crossing lines and a fourth line marked g crossed by two short strokes. Middle: three crossing strokes, and below them a star of three lines through a heavy point. Right: two crossing strokes; under them a long line crossed by three strokes, labelled g' and g'' at its right end (the formula g' + g'' = g follows in the transcription). Strokes placed by eye; which stroke carries which label is a reading.

drawings.description: une chaîne de composantes rationnelles marquée $g = 0$, avec « $(g = 0$ » ; un ovale ; un arc portant des points épaissis, accompagné de croix ; plusieurs étoiles de droites concourantes ; un pentagone de droites marqué de points ; deux lettres $k$ isolées
drawings.kind: page of sketches of stable curves
drawings.notes: Whole-page sketches, three groups. Top right: crossing strokes, and a chain of components - a long line crossed by three strokes ending in a blot - marked g = 0, with "(g = 0" further right. Lower left: a thick arc with two heavy end points crossed by a star of thin strokes; a second thick arc carrying three thickened points with small crosses beside it; the two letters k. Lower middle: an oval; a configuration of three lines marked 1; a pentagon of five lines carrying three points; two stars of concurrent lines and a small cross. The rays of the stars are approximate (number and direction read by eye).

figures.what: arcs with thickened points, crosses, letters k
oval, lines marked 1, stars, pentagon of lines with points

drawings.description: en marge gauche, une suite de croquis de courbes : une boucle à point double, des configurations de droites concourantes, un point marqué « 1 » ; d'autres croquis en bas de page
drawings.notes: Left margin, top to bottom: a loop with a double point (a long stroke through the heavy double point, the loop closing on the right, two short strokes crossing it); three crossing lines; two lines through two points and a third line, one end marked 1. The "other sketches at the bottom of the page" are those of 08-6 and are drawn there.

drawings.description: plusieurs configurations de composantes concourantes ; une boucle à point double ; un arc portant un point épaissi
drawings.notes: Lower half of the page: about eight configurations of concurrent or crossing lines (some with a heavy point at the meeting), one inside a bracket-like arc; a loop with a double point beside nu_s >= 3; a thick arc carrying a thickened point. The configurations are schematic: the number and direction of strokes in the denser ones are approximate. The formula in the upper right (2(c_0 + rho) - ...) is text and is left out.

figures.what: configurations of crossing lines (left and centre)
loop with double point; arc with a thick point

drawings.description: une courbe ondulée, à trois bosses, tracée en travers des dernières lignes encadrées ; elle figure sans doute les composantes connexes de $G_{\bar k}$
drawings.notes: A wavy pencil curve drawn across the last boxed lines, with three troughs and the humps between them, closing on the right in a stroke down to the frame; the boxed lines and their text are not drawn.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, une figure en éventail : quatre triangles adjacents partant d'un même sommet, coupés par un arc
drawings.kind: fan of triangles cut by an arc
drawings.notes: Visible on the facsimile: two triangles with a common vertex (the upper one opening to the right, the lower one downwards); a long, almost straight pencil stroke runs down the margin through the lower triangle, and a faint arc leaves the lower triangle downwards beside it.
drawings.disagreement: Only two adjacent triangles are visible, not four.

drawings.notes: X <-(Gamma) A x_S B, f: X -> Y and pr_1: A x_S B -> B down, Y <-(Gamma) B, g: Y -> S down, and an oblique stroke from B towards S. The "Gamma" under the lower arrow is read as in the transcription; a fragment at the lower left (part of the text) is left out.

drawings.notes: Two long, nearly horizontal lines crossing (with a third stroke along one of them), and to their right a brace and p.
